dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible perimeters of 3-5 prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit thin, irregular high-intensity borders with sharp gradient transitions to darker interior centers. The geometries are predominantly elliptical with jagged, non-uniform edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. Concentration is highest in the anterior neck region, transitioning to a more sparse, interspersed pattern among the annuli on the lateral midsection.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most defined lateral annuli form an obtuse triangle. A series of high-intensity blobs in the neck region forms a curved linear path following the dorsal silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A wide, diffuse band of high-intensity texture creates a distinct collar-like visual feature around the posterior neck region.
